verdict.rationale: Pylon's Support Agent build docs mention a default persona whose settings can be tuned to get the desired behavior, which is a product-native lever for agent voice. They never explicitly describe tone or brand-voice controls. Runbooks and skills cover scenario and workflow instructions rather than voice, and chat-widget branding is visual only, so none of these add credit. Missing for 10: explicit tone/brand-voice configuration documentation, evidence of consistency across topics, multilingual voice consistency, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I control the agent's tone and brand voice, and it stays consistent across topics and languages

citations.quote: We recommend starting with the default persona, then tuning the settings in order to get the behavior you want.
